source.snippet: In regulated research environments (biotech, pharma), exported PDF documents must contain a visible watermark identifying the exporter and the time of export to prevent unauthorized sharing and maintain traceability. Currently, eLabFTW has no built-in mechanism to add custom watermarks to generated PDFs. Introduce a configuration option (sysconfig) that enables automatic watermarking on all exported PDFs.

problem_statement: Biotech and pharma research teams using electronic lab notebooks must add auditable watermarks (exporter identity + timestamp) to every exported PDF for regulatory compliance, but current open-source ELN tools like eLabFTW lack this feature, forcing manual workarounds or custom integrations.
target_segment: IT admins and compliance officers at biotech/pharma companies and CROs using open-source electronic lab notebook (ELN) software
notes: Strong buyer context: regulated industries (biotech/pharma) have non-negotiable compliance requirements and dedicated IT/compliance budgets. The feature request references specific regulatory traceability requirements — these organizations pay for validated software and compliance tooling. A plugin, SaaS wrapper, or managed ELN with built-in compliance features could command premium pricing. Opportunity may extend beyond eLabFTW to other open-source ELNs (OpenBIS, SciNote) with the same gap.
